name: Timeline
purpose: Present a static ordered chronology with connected event markers.
useWhen: Authored events need a chronological visual connection.

avoidWhen.condition: Users navigate progress or workflow stages.
Content is a live activity stream.

composition: Compose direct Root > Item > Connector and Content; Connector contains Indicator and Separator.
Use For for data collections and authored time elements for localized timestamps.

rules.statement: Preserve native ol/li order. Decorative Connector and Indicator cannot contain interactive controls; repeat status in Content.
Use Content side before or after for logical placement; do not add empty content wrappers or page-colored connector masks.
Load styles.css or core.css plus timeline.css and styles for composed owners.
Use sparse responsive size/variant/layout maps, PropsProvider for shared visual defaults and compact layout for leading date metadata. Responsive maps replace whole; explicit root props win.

Keep semantic event tones meaningful. For category paint use paired --brick-timeline-fill/ink/border hooks, not fake status tones. Inherited geometry overrides belong on Root or its ancestor; nested roots intentionally inherit public overrides.

Unstyled removes recipe classes but preserves semantic hosts and decorative attributes. Root choice applies to parts, not nested Roots. asChild uses public Atom composition; preserve list grammar and ref cleanup.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Timeline as an interactive stepper.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Steps for current-step state and navigation.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding custom CSS to stretch markers or draw connector lines.
commonMistakes.correction: Use the component's Indicator geometry and Separator anatomy.

validation: Check marker squares, stretched separators, final-line policy, rich content, reading order, narrow width, RTL, forced colors and nested surfaces.
